en:
It's not good to do stuff that'll make a girl
upset, y'know?

But still, doesn't it bug you that she won't
let us in? I wonder why...
...What? Are you going to yell at me now?
Ah, no, not at all...
...Then go away.

<CLT=cltMIND>From the look of this door...
This must be an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Research Lab<CLT=cltMIND>.

Based on the design, this might be
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Tennis Pro<CLT=cltNORMAL>'s lab.

<CLT=cltMIND>What would be in here?
Probably rackets and training equipment.
Kaito Momota's Lab
Classroom A
Classroom B

<CLT=cltMIND>From the look of this door...
This must be an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Research Lab<CLT=cltMIND>.

...I have no idea what kind, though.
I should take a look inside...

<CLT=cltMIND>As I reached my hand to
the doorknob...
...I did not give you permission to enter.
Ah! Maki?

So this is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Child Caregiver<CLT=cltNORMAL>'s lab.
...You wouldn't think so, judging by the door—
You're right. Goodbye.
W-Wait! Can I look inside for a bit?
No.

What? But...there's no rule against people
going into each other's labs...

I don't care about the rules. I'm not letting
anyone inside.
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh? What's going on...?

Heeeeyyy! What's going on? You guys aren't
in the middle of a tiff now, are you?

...See? Thanks to you, an annoying brat
has showed up.

You hear that, Shuichi? An annoying brat
has showed up, all because of you!
Y-Yeah...

So, what's up? You don't want anyone
to enter your lab, Maki?

Don't be so pushy, Shuichi. It's not good to
do stuff that'll make a girl upset, y'know?
Ah, okay... I understand.

Good, then stay away. If you try to go inside,
it would be extremely painful...
...for you.
Painful!?

What is this...?
It looks like a door, but...
<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, I see. It's just a painting of a door.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like a video game...
I think this is called pixel art.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>They really are everywhere...
They want us to know we're under their control.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it doesn't have any surveillance
equipment to spy on us.
